item.title: "All Men Are Pigs"
item.content:encoded:
With the article title "All Men Are Pigs" I was disappointed to discover that this wasn't a Radical Feminist, SCUM Manifesto-related SCP. I'd like to think that its anomalous effects only manifest themselves when the subject possesses a Y chromosome.

All men are pigs, indeed. Tasty, dry-cured, smoked bacon pigs to be specific.

This, in my head, adds an extra layer of sexual politics-based humour to the weirdness, a quality quite rarely exhibited by most SCPs.

EDIT: Anyway, despite the lack of Rad Fem misandry, I still like it. +1

Very neatly disconcerting.
